en.title: Airplane makes unexpected landing in Lyon due to burning powerbank
en.summary: A Lufthansa aircraft traveling from Frankfurt to Lisbon diverted to Lyon on Saturday evening after a powerbank caught fire near a passenger seat.

en.summary: Israel has expelled Dutch diplomats from Palestinian territories following the Netherlands' decision to impose an import ban.

en.title: Netherlands plays sluggishly but wins deservedly against Serbia: good start under new coach Xavi
en.summary: The Dutch national team defeated Serbia 2-1 in an away match with two goals from AZ striker Mexx Meerdink, creating numerous chances despite some defensive vulnerabilities.

en.summary: Israel has revoked the diplomatic status of Dutch diplomats in Ramallah in response to the Netherlands imposing a trade ban on products from occupied West Bank settlements.

en.title: Israel expels Dutch diplomats from Ramallah over Israeli product boycott
en.summary: Israel has withdrawn diplomatic status from Dutch diplomats in Ramallah on the occupied West Bank, requiring them to leave within seven days, citing the Netherlands' import ban on goods from illegal settlements.

en.summary: The Dutch national team won 2-1 against Serbia in a Nations League match, with striker Mexx Meerdink scoring twice in his first game as a starter under coach Xavi Hérnandez.

en.title: British police arrest five men accused of planning attack on air base used by US to strike Iran
en.summary: Five men have been arrested by British police on suspicion of planning an attack on RAF Fairford, a base from which the United States conducts military operations against Iranian targets. Iran's Revolutionary Guards previously designated the base as a legitimate target.
